summary.text: Gary Day is a Republican member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 187, which he has represented since December 2024, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Day earned a B.A. in economics from Pennsylvania State University.
His professional experience includes working as an executive assistant to the Mayor of Allentown, as a director of marketing, in human resources and public relations, and as a consultant.
Day assumed office in the House on December 1, 2024, succeeding Ryan Mackenzie.
Ballotpedia also lists earlier service in the District 187 seat that ended in 2022.
